name: Madison Medical, a Breg Company
old_description: Improving quality of life by providing creative solutions for joint rehabilitation and health.
about:
Madison Medical, a Breg Company, operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The business was established in 2001 as part of Breg, Inc., which traces its roots to 1989 when it started as a sports medicine company focused on high-quality bracing and cold therapy in Carlsbad, California.

The company designs and manufactures orthopedic bracing and cold therapy devices, and provides consulting, technology, and durable medical equipment (DME) program management. Its portfolio includes more than 320 product styles and sizes. With approximately 1,500 employees across the United States and Mexico, Madison Medical supports a global distribution network reaching 59 countries.

Madison Medical serves the orthopedic care, sports medicine, and durable medical equipment sectors. Its customer base includes more than 9,700 clinics, 38,000 orthopedic providers, and 300-plus integrated delivery networks, collectively serving almost two million patients each year.

The company emphasizes a total-solutions approach that integrates bracing, cold therapy, consulting, and technology to improve patient outcomes and lower the cost of care. It cites a culture of quality, performance, and collaboration, along with sustainability initiatives such as plastic reduction in packaging, energy efficiency investments, and participation in the EPA SmartWay® program for logistics.
